mapper.select: SELECT osr.*, o.code AS op_code, o.name AS op_name, sk.code AS skill_code, sk.name AS skill_name FROM mdm_op_skill_req osr LEFT JOIN mdm_op o ON o.id = osr.op_id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_skill sk ON sk.id = osr.skill_id AND sk.deleted = 0 WHERE osr.deleted = 0 AND osr.op_id = #{opId} ORDER BY osr.op_id ASC, osr.id ASC
